## General conventions

- Use TypeScript.
- Run `pnpm test`.

## Code style

- Prefer named exports.

## Path-specific rules

### Files matching `src/api/**/*.ts`

- Validate request bodies.

### Files matching `**/*.test.ts`, `e2e/**`

- Use vitest.

## Optional guidance

Apply these only when they are relevant to the task.

### How to cut a release

1. Bump the version.
2. Tag it.
